## Checklist
- [ ] English only (code, comments, UI text)
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`python -m pytest -q`)
- [ ] Statistics come from `trend_stats.py`; numbers shown to users validated (`stats-validator`)
- [ ] Data: catalog/provenance updated; no secrets; no large raw files
- [ ] Visuals follow `trend-viz` (palette, units, CI, alt text)
- [ ] SI assistance logged in `docs/08-si-usage-log.md` (if applicable)
- [ ] References added to `docs/09-references.md` (new libs/data/images)
